# News 4 San Antonio

> WOAI NBC News Channel 4 delivers breaking local news, weather, sports, and community coverage for San Antonio and South Central Texas.

News 4 San Antonio is the primary local news source for the San Antonio, Texas area, operated by NBC. The site covers breaking news, local investigations, weather, entertainment, and special series on national issues affecting the community.

## Key Topics

- San Antonio
- Texas
- Bexar County
- Breaking News
- Local News
- Public Safety
- Crime
- Weather
- Traffic Accidents
- Community Stories
- Houston
- Calhoun County
- Drowning Incidents
- Opioid Crisis
- Elections

## Core News Sections

- [San Antonio News, Weather, Sports, Breaking News](https://news4sanantonio.com): WOAI NBC News Channel 4 homepage with local news, weather, and community coverage
- [Local](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local): Local news section aggregating San Antonio and South Central Texas coverage
- [Nation & World](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/nation-world): National and international news coverage including Iran conflict and US military
- [Entertainment](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/entertainment): Entertainment news section covering celebrity gossip, TV shows, and pop culture

## Breaking Local Stories

- [12-year-old boy killed in suspected street racing crash identified](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/12-year-old-boy-killed-in-suspected-street-racing-crash-identified-san-antonio-texas-investigation-bexar-county-medical-examiner): Jonathan Rivera identified as victim in fatal San Antonio street racing incident
- [Texas teenager lost 3 limbs after flu and strep complications](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/texas-teenager-lost-3-limbs-after-flu-and-strep-complications-houston-kerrville-san-antonio-doctors-surgery-heart-distress): Kerrville teen Kaydin Ruiz faces triple amputation from flu and strep infection
- [Father, 4-year-old son found dead after drowning at Hog Bayou](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/father-4-year-old-son-found-dead-after-drowning-at-hog-bayou): Tragic drowning incident at Hog Bayou in Calhoun County claims father and child
- [Dangerous Dogs](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/dangerous-dogs): San Antonio dog attack incidents and animal control safety coverage

## Investigative & Special Series

- [Addicted America](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/addicted-america): Opioid crisis and substance abuse coverage including fentanyl and addiction recovery
- [Spotlight on America](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/spotlight-on-america): Investigative journalism series on national issues including cybersecurity and health
- [Criminally Obsessed](https://news4sanantonio.com/criminally-obsessed): True crime documentary series covering murder cases and missing persons investigations
- [Amazing America](https://news4sanantonio.com/amazing-america): Travel and feature series exploring American attractions and regional culture

## Politics & Government

- [Beyond The Podium](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/beyond-the-podium): Political news and analysis covering elections, campaigns, and government policy
- [Connect to Congress](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/connect-to-congress): Congressional news and legislative coverage with political analysis and updates
- [POLL: Should Cesar Chavez Boulevard be renamed?](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/local/poll-should-cesar-chavez-boulevard-be-renamed-san-antonio-texas-bexar-county-civil-rights): Community poll on renaming Cesar Chavez Boulevard amid labor rights legacy debate

## Community & Features

- [Pay It 4-Ward](https://news4sanantonio.com/features/pay-it-4-ward): Community service recognition program highlighting San Antonio nonprofits and charity
- [Offbeat](https://news4sanantonio.com/news/offbeat): Quirky and unusual news stories including viral content and human interest pieces
- [Question of the Day](https://news4sanantonio.com/question): Interactive daily polling on current political and civic engagement issues
